versions.name: Cole Canoe Base

features.note: White Pines Cabin has bunk beds, a full kitchen, and indoor restrooms and showers.
Canoe trips on the Rifle River, offered spring through autumn.
Some campsites have their own pavilion.
A Scout can attend without their unit at a provisional fee.
A family camp with sixteen RV sites, twelve of them with full hook-ups.
The camp trading post is called The River Store.
The camp fronts the Rifle River.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident camp operated by the Michigan Crossroads Council, situated on the Rifle River near Alger, Michigan.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
